significance: A major shrine of Ramanathapuram district, one of the fourteen Tevaram-praised Shiva temples of the Pandya country and of the 275 Paadal Petra Sthalams, its gopuram carrying fine Dravidian work.
story: Vaaruni, cursed to bear an elephant's body with a goat's head, is said to have regained his form by worshipping Shiva here, giving Tiruvadanai its name.
